research_notes: 2026-10-01 initial research: official full biography and first speech; MP career/mission accounts; two local direct interviews; primary Westerly archive; Hansard mission evidence. Frozen six occupations retained.

Part-time paralegal evidence is substantive but unallocated by firm/date; neither firm treated as proven full-time. Freelance, law, teaching and political-staff intervals overlap2001–2009, preventing additive duration arithmetic. No new totals derived.

Searched Curtin historical lecturer/annual-report material, law-firm name plus full/part-time, public professional profiles and publication archives. No personal fraction or firm records found. Numerous namesakes (including Fremantle Ports planner, musician and US lawyers) excluded. PublisherPDF direct open Internal Error; publisher contents usable.

New earlier newspaper-selling role needs agency name and dates. Study years, unpublished writing pay, clients and teaching contract need follow-up. Artsource studio occupancy is not employment by Artsource.

Asia Foundation assignment has month start and exact departure, but pay, weekly hours and political-office leave remain unknown. Visit to Fred Hollows clinic is not employment there; TAF NGO funding is not government control.

Follow-up: law-firm employment/fractions and IUD class-action project attribution; Curtin contracts/annual reports; freelance clients/dates; university attendance; observer contract/leave; any work in2018parliamentary gap.
